guidance.inspection: Entail only when return or destruction is mandatory upon termination, expiration, rejection, conclusion, or ceasing interest. A request-only duty remains NotMentioned even if termination is addressed elsewhere; never join separate triggers. Retain actor, object, action, trigger, and governing preamble.

Entail only if every protected item must be expressly marked or identified by the disclosing party, including any oral-confirmation rule. Contradict when the definition expressly offers a non-identification alternative such as reasonable understanding, circumstances, or automatic inclusion. Do not infer either relation from a missing marking clause; retain the full alternatives.

any_phrases: information marked in writing as confidential
should know is treated as confidential

guidance.inspection: Entail when the recipient may independently develop or independently derive information without using, accessing, or referring to protected information. Retain the exclusion or permission preamble and proof conditions. Information derived from protected information, prior possession, third-party receipt, or mere competitive activity does not establish independent development.

Require an operative permission or exception for employees, internal staff, or receiving-party representatives—not a bare actor definition. Retain need-to-know, purpose, undertaking, notice, and responsibility conditions. Under the observed labels, an operative permission to a defined receiving-party representative class is sufficient; unrelated employee mentions are not.

any_phrases: internal information technology and management staff

guidance.inspection: Entail from an express no-right, no-license, ownership, or reservation provision concerning protected information. A limited right expressly carved out must be considered, but access, evaluation, review, or purpose-limited use alone is not a rights grant and cannot contradict the hypothesis. Retain independently redundant ownership and no-grant clauses.

Entail if an operative nondisclosure rule directly covers the agreement, its existence or terms, or discussions or negotiations. Coverage may arise by defining those subjects as Confidential Information plus a general confidentiality duty; retain both provisions. Compelled-disclosure procedure is not substitute evidence for the underlying secrecy duty.

any_phrases: agreement and the terms contained herein
fact that a meeting or discussion

guidance.inspection: Entail only from language continuing an identified obligation after termination, expiration, completion, abandonment, return, or destruction. Cite the continuation sentence, affected duty, duration, endpoint, and necessary preamble—not a retention exception alone. Reject a bare termination right or accrued-remedies clause.

Entail when legal, regulatory, governmental, subpoena, court, or administrative compulsion requires the recipient to notify, inform, or consult the disclosing party. Retain the trigger, timing, recipient, and protective-order mechanism. Reject unauthorized-use notices and bare compelled-disclosure permission.

any_phrases: provide the disclosing party with prompt notice
after consultation with the other party

guidance.inspection: Inspect personnel-solicitation restrictions for actor, employee or representative targets, duration, consent, covered contacts, and exceptions. Follow enumerated target classes, but reject proxy solicitation and unrelated standstill language.

Entail only from an affirmative necessary-purpose copy exception or acknowledged automatic-copy circumstance. A prohibition on copying without consent, standing alone, is Contradiction under the observed labels; consent being imaginable is not affirmative permission. Retain actor, object, purpose, consent, quantity, and exceptions; archival retention is not creation.

Entail if an express exception permits specified material to remain after a return or destruction duty. Contradict if the operative rule requires return or destruction of all protected material or copies and supplies no retention exception. Otherwise use NotMentioned. Retain the governing return rule, exception, holder, purpose, access limits, duration, and continuing duties.

any_phrases: no copies thereof shall be retained except

guidance.inspection: Contradict only when the protected-information definition expressly includes a nontechnical subject such as business, financial, marketing, customer, personnel, contact, or operational information. Generic breadth, form language, transaction references, or an auxiliary definition of all information does not alone prove nontechnical subject matter. Retain the definition and governing list introduction.

Entail when the protected class expressly includes oral or verbal information, even if later writing or identification is required. A written-marking category without any oral statement is not a contradiction; it leaves the hypothesis unsettled. Reject oral negotiations and compelled oral questions unrelated to the definition.

any_phrases: irrespective of the form of communication
whether or not such information is also disclosed orally

guidance.inspection: Entail from an exclusion or permission allowing information received or becoming available from someone other than the disclosing party, subject to lawful provenance and no confidentiality duty. Retain its preamble and knowledge, timing, and proof conditions. Information originally supplied by the disclosing party's vendors, or independent development, is not third-party acquisition.

any_phrases: becomes available to the receiving party

guidance.inspection: Entail only from an operative disclosure or access permission for a nonemployee class; a class definition, marking rule, or unrelated mention is insufficient. Retain need-to-know, purpose, consent, undertaking, and responsibility conditions. An exclusive employee-only permission with no nonemployee exception contradicts; absence of permission is NotMentioned.

Entail from an operative rule limiting use of protected information to the agreement's stated purpose or forbidding other uses. Contradict when the contract affirmatively permits protected information or residuals for broader internal or any purposes. A copying exception, disclosure permission, ownership clause, or license clause alone does not decide use scope.

Inspect reverse engineering, decompilation, or disassembly language for actor, prohibited action, protected object, purpose, and exceptions. Unrelated product restrictions and general confidentiality duties do not settle the hypothesis; no hit is not a verdict.

Entail only when the same operative duty makes return or destruction mandatory upon termination, expiration, rejection, conclusion, or ceasing interest. A request-at-any-time duty is NotMentioned even if another clause separately terminates the agreement; never transfer triggers across clauses. Retain the governing trigger, actor, action, object, copies, and alternative return/destruction terms.

operations.rationale: The draft repeatedly converted request-only return duties into termination-triggered entailments. Broader acquisition plus an explicit same-clause trigger test preserves split-list evidence without authorizing that inference.

guidance.inspection: Entail only from an operative exclusion or permission for independent development or derivation without using, accessing, or referring to protected information. Retain its preamble and proof conditions. Third-party receipt, prior possession, information derived from protected material, or permission to conduct competing activity cannot establish independent development. If no such clause is found, do not infer its opposite or NotMentioned from query results alone.

operations.rationale: This prevents the observed unsupported independent-development conclusion from a third-party or derived-information clause while retaining the successful exclusion patterns.

guidance.inspection: Entail from an operative disclosure or access permission covering employees, internal staff, people within the recipient's organization, or a defined receiving-party representative or agent class used by the benchmark. A definition alone is insufficient: retain both it and the operative permission, plus need-to-know, purpose, undertaking, notice, and responsibility conditions. Reject unrelated employee or representative mentions.

any_phrases: internal information technology and management staff

operations.rationale: Visible operative representative clauses were rejected in two B3 cases. The update states the observed sufficient class relation and still requires decision-bearing permission rather than a bare definition.

guidance.inspection: Entail only when an operative nondisclosure rule covers the agreement, its existence or terms, or the existence, content, status, or terms of discussions or negotiations. If coverage is supplied through a definition, retain that subject-defining provision and the general secrecy duty. Do not treat ordinary references to an agreement, transaction, Confidential Information, compelled disclosure, or a confidentiality duration as responsive evidence.

business negotiations discussions consultations or agreements in progress
announcement relating to the possible transaction

operations.rationale: The draft's broad agreement query produced extensive unrelated citations and false entailments. Exact subject phrases acquire the decision-bearing secrecy clauses while excluding generic agreement references.

guidance.inspection: Entail only when legal, regulatory, governmental, subpoena, court, or administrative compulsion triggers notice, information, or consultation by the recipient to the disclosing party. Retain the compulsion trigger, notice duty, timing, recipient, and protective-order or challenge mechanism, including split clauses. Unauthorized-use notice and bare permission to disclose are not sufficient.

any_phrases: provide the disclosing party with prompt notice

operations.rationale: B3 answers omitted governing compelled-disclosure text or cited an unauthorized-copy notice. Separate trigger and notice queries support split drafting while the inspection requires their legal relation.

guidance.inspection: Entail only from an affirmative necessary-purpose copying exception, copies expressly required for authorized use, or an acknowledged automatic process that creates copies. Contradict when the operative rule merely prohibits copying or reproduction without consent or approval; the possibility of later consent is not affirmative permission under the observed labels. Otherwise use NotMentioned. Retain actor, object, purpose, quantity, consent condition, and governing preamble; archival retention is not copy creation.

any_phrases: except for the purpose of disclosure

operations.rationale: This directly addresses both recurrent errors: treating consent-conditioned prohibitions as permission and missing plural necessary-purpose copy exceptions.

guidance.inspection: Entail only if an express exception permits specified protected material or copies to remain after the governing return or destruction duty. Contradict when that duty requires return or destruction of all protected material or copies and contains no retention exception, including request-triggered duties. Otherwise use NotMentioned. Retain the duty, exception, holder, material, purpose, access limit, duration, and continuing confidentiality terms; physical persistence without permission is insufficient.

any_phrases: no copies thereof shall be retained except
return to the disclosing party all confidential

operations.rationale: The draft sometimes downgraded an unqualified all-material return command to NotMentioned. The revised three-way test makes that command contradictory while preserving explicit archival, legal, and regulatory exceptions.

guidance.inspection: Contradict only when the decision-bearing protected-information definition, or a definition it expressly incorporates, includes a nontechnical subject such as business, financial, marketing, customer, personnel, contact, or operational information. Retain the whole definitional chain and list introduction. Generic breadth, form language, transaction references, use restrictions, return clauses, or an unrelated definition of Information do not prove nontechnical protected scope.

operations.rationale: Broad information queries returned market-abuse, return, and other non-definitional noise, causing unsupported contradictions. The update ties the sufficient condition to the protected definition itself.

guidance.inspection: Entail only from an operative disclosure or access permission for a named nonemployee service class such as agents, consultants, contractors, counsel, advisers, or representatives. Retain any class definition with the permission and all need-to-know, purpose, consent, undertaking, and responsibility conditions. A mailing list, group participant, generic third party, class definition, or unrelated mention is insufficient. An exclusive employee-only permission contradicts; absence of either relation is NotMentioned.

operations.rationale: This rejects the observed false positive based on a participant mailing list while preserving operative permissions for professional and representative classes.

guidance.inspection: Entail from an operative rule limiting use of protected information to the agreement's stated purpose or prohibiting every other use. any_phrases: free to use for any purposes

operations.rationale: The draft treated broader internal-business use as support and a copying exception as a use limitation. The revised polarity test makes the observed contrast explicit.
